name: vscode-yaml
description: YAML Language Support by Red Hat, with built-in Kubernetes syntax support

works: Diagnostics while typing, including JSON Schema validation
Completion and hover from a modeline schema, yaml.schemas or the schemastore.org catalog
The schema in the status bar, a schema picker on click, and a lens that opens the schema
Format Document and format on type (editor.formatOnType)
Go to Symbol in Editor, Go to Definition and rename of anchors and aliases, $ref links
Quick fixes such as Delete unused anchor
Without the network, schemas from URLs are skipped and the document is still checked as YAML
limits: Hover shows schema descriptions as plain text: Diode has no Markdown renderer
The status bar item is cut at 24 cells, so a schema set by URL shows only the start of the URL

readme:
# YAML

YAML language support from Red Hat's yaml-language-server: validation, completion and hover from JSON Schema, formatting, outline and navigation. Schemas come from a `# yaml-language-server: $schema=...` modeline, the `yaml.schemas` setting or the schemastore.org catalog (GitHub workflows, Docker Compose, Kubernetes and more).

The extension asks about Red Hat telemetry on start; turn it off with `"redhat.telemetry.enabled": false`.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
